full_judgment: 9. Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed next submits that the proceeding under Order 21 rule 90 CPC was terminated upon issuance of the sale certificates to the auction-purchaser who has obtained possession of the properties and therefore mere setting aside of auction or the order dated 23-1-96 is not effective and complete reversal of the legal position and, as such, the order of the High Court Division is not sustainable in law.
